chats.answer:
For a 15-inch MacBook Air, I'd choose the Mobile Pixels Duex Max DS if you want a screen that attaches to your laptop and slides out beside it. If you'll mostly work at a desk, I'd choose a freestanding USB-C monitor instead: it puts no extra weight on the Air's thin lid and is easier to position.

Best options

Mobile Pixels Duex Max DS

$175.99

Walmart

Best attached extender. A 14.1-inch, 1080p screen that slides out beside your Air and works over one USB-C cable without a driver. The compromise is noticeably less-sharp text than your MacBook's screen, plus extra weight on the lid. 
Dealectric

ASUS ZenScreen MB16ACV

$169.99

newegg.com

Best simple desk companion. Its freestanding 15.6-inch, 1080p panel is close in physical size to the Air's display. One USB-C cable handles video and power, and the kickstand lets you position it independently.

Mobile Pixels Duex Float 2 Pro

Best for sharper text and small tables. Its 16-inch, 2560×1600 screen sits above your MacBook, giving you a taller workspace rather than a wide one. It weighs 2.9 lb, so it's a substantial addition to an Air. 
Macworld

Check your MacBook Air's chip before buying two extra screens

One added USB-C screen works with every 15-inch Air. Two added screens are where compatibility matters:

M2: One external display natively.

M3: Two external displays natively only with the MacBook lid closed.

M4 or M5: Two external displays natively while keeping the MacBook screen on.

For an M2 or M3 Air, a triple-screen setup with the laptop open needs a compatible USB graphics solution, such as DisplayLink, and its macOS software. Don't assume a generic dual-screen extender will work just because it has USB-C. 
Dealectric
+2

My pick: Buy the Duex Max DS for an attached travel setup; choose the Float 2 Pro if you spend hours reading code or documents and can carry the extra weight. I assumed you want portable productivity rather than gaming or color-critical work. I haven't physically tested these on your Air, and your chip and budget are still unknown.
